resources.string: FreeKiosk uses this service to send keyboard input and remote control commands to apps running on this device. This is required for the REST API remote control feature to work in external app mode.
Web page URL for WebView mode (e.g. Home Assistant dashboard)
Lock the device to kiosk mode (lock task)
Automatically start FreeKiosk when the device boots
numeric = digits only; alphanumeric = letters, numbers, and symbols (up to 20 characters)
Package name when display_mode is external_app (e.g. com.example.app)
Sets PIN on apply only if no PIN is configured yet. Not recommended for production — prefer ADB provisioning for secrets.
